falsified_prior_mechanism.training_defect: teacher-forced curriculum responses share a dominant generic continuation, permitting low held-out instruction loss without autonomous prompt dependence

hypothesis.claim: A compact bidirectional prompt encoder, learned semantic control slots, low-rank cross-attention reads, and neural pointer generation trained with self-generated-prefix recovery will make autonomous output causally prompt-dependent without surrendering the fast sparse decoder.
hypothesis.material_difference_from_closed_branches: Closed prompt memories pooled uncontextualized or locally convolved prompt embeddings. This branch contextualizes the complete prompt bidirectionally before bounded compression, separates latent task/control records from lexical records, and trains recovery from model-generated rather than exclusively gold prefixes.
hypothesis.decoder: existing incremental sparse word-byte-hybrid LayerCake decoder
hypothesis.decode_read: one low-rank semantic-slot read plus one contextual lexical pointer read per generated unit

training_contract.curriculum: knowledge-light diverse supplied-context and English-control tasks

systems_optimization_rule: At most one profiler-directed runtime optimization, only after behavioral quality passes and speed or RSS is within 10 percent of its gate.
early_stop_rule: Reject the branch if the initial run and the predeclared same-lineage curve extension fail the development behavior gates. Do not rescue it with nearby slot, width, pointer, auxiliary-weight, or decoder sweeps.
promotion_rule: Only one integrated checkpoint lineage may supply quality, behavior, speed, TTFT, RSS, sparsity, incremental-state, and ABI evidence.
